Differentiation at zero is justified for alpha*p<1; fractional beta-layer coefficient follows from a positive beta-integrable kernel and dominated convergence. Since the leading coefficient is positive, a small two-pulse perturbation produces strict amplification. The standalone verification code checks exact finite identities and asymptotic diagnostics; it is not relied on for the universal theorem.
